verdict.rationale: Stripe (the platform Terminal sits on) exposes a Disputes object/API, webhook events for real-time notifications, and even 'Smart Disputes' to automate evidence collection, plus an official MCP server letting AI agents call the Stripe API — together these could support an agent watching dispute deadlines and preparing evidence. But nothing describes deadline-specific webhook triggers, an agent drafting evidence for human review (Smart Disputes is described as automating submission, not human-reviewed drafts), and none of this is Terminal-specific functionality. Missing for 10: explicit dispute-deadline webhook/event documentation, agent-drafted-evidence-for-review workflow, and Terminal-specific dispute handling.
